baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled interrogative construction joins أَدْرَىٰ to the unexplained definite noun ٱلْحُطَمَةُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing is presented as something caused in the addressee, while the named object supplies an image of hard matter reduced to fragments. The verse therefore stages a threshold: the name alone does not make its referent knowable; disclosure must reconstruct it from an otherwise category-breaking effect.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and causing another to know makes the interrogative an event of induced awareness rather than a request for a dictionary label.
Breaking dry or hard matter into crumbs supplies the disruptive effect whose identity the question withholds.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply asks what a named punishment is.
changed_reading.after: The verse dramatizes the failure of ordinary recognition and promises a caused knowing adequate to a thing recognized by its pulverizing effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intensive noun ٱلْحُطَمَةُ is anchored in the focus root's crumbling and consuming branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can name not merely an impact but an active processor: it takes resistant wholes, breaks them into debris, and consumes or grinds what enters it. The definite noun leaves open whether this is an agent, place, or process, so all three functional shapes remain live.

activation_trace.role: Crumbling a hard whole into fragments gives the mechanism its input-to-debris transformation.
The glutton or grinder that consumes like fire makes the noun an active, appetite-like processor.

changed_reading.before: Al-Hutamah is a static proper name for a destination.
changed_reading.after: Al-Hutamah is also readable as a functioning crusher-consumer whose operation matters as much as its location.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun carries branches of severe-year loss, bodily wearing-down, and the perishability of worldly goods.
baseline_models.mechanism: Crushing need not be instantaneous. A harsh season can break people and property, long duration can wear down a body, and worldly display can already be debris-in-waiting. These branches sustain a temporal and ecological model in which the Hutamah is a regime of depletion.

activation_trace.role: A severe year that breaks people and property expands crushing from a blow into an environmental duration.
Age or prolonged association wearing down the body supplies cumulative attrition rather than sudden fracture.
Perishing worldly goods make apparent solidity a temporary arrangement already tending toward debris.

changed_reading.before: Crushing is imagined as one catastrophic strike.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also name prolonged scarcity, erosion, and loss that steadily convert bodies and possessions into remnants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired social agents operate through encompassing pressure, squeezing, prodding, and pushing. When those motions meet the focus branch of a harsh driver who crushes a flock together, the Hutamah becomes a magnified return of the offender's own interpersonal mechanics: repeated small social compressions become total crushing.

activation_trace.role: A violent driver crowding and damaging a flock gives the focus an agentive model of coercive social compression.
Completion and encompassing totality scale the paired acts from isolated incidents into a comprehensive pattern.
Hand-pressure and squeezing make the verbal offense materially legible as compression.
A prod that moves its target adds repeated directed force to the social mechanism.
Pushing through lamz completes the sequence from verbal marking to displacement of another person.

structural_cues: 104:1 places a totalizing term before two paired agent nouns, and both agents precede the focus noun that names the crusher.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, pressure, prodding, pushing, and harsh crowding; I supply the retributive arrow by which the offender's micro-mechanics return at a larger scale. A live alternative is that these roots characterize only the offender while the Hutamah's mechanics are unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The crusher is an externally assigned penalty disconnected from the preceding conduct.
changed_reading.after: The crusher mirrors and totalizes the offender's own practice of pressuring, prodding, and socially crushing others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context builds a preservation machine: dispersed units are assembled as wealth, counted, and imagined to confer permanence. The focus branch that calls worldly goods perishing debris reverses every operation. Aggregation tends toward disaggregation, the counted becomes rubble, and the hoped-for permanence becomes evidence of misrecognized perishability.

activation_trace.role: Worldly wealth as perishing debris supplies the reversal's terminal state.
Joining dispersed pieces into a collected whole supplies the operation that the crusher undoes.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth identifies what is being assembled and treated as durable.
Enumeration turns the collection into controlled, repeatedly verified units.
Durable persistence supplies the imagined outcome that the debris branch contradicts.

structural_cues: 104:2 sequences collecting, wealth, and counting; 104:3 repeats wealth and predicates an imagined permanence before 104:5 asks about the Hutamah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, wealth, enumeration, permanence, and perishing debris; I infer an operation-level reversal from making-whole to breaking-apart. The alternative is a simpler moral sequence in which wealth is only the motive and is not structurally reversed by the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The Hutamah destroys a person who happens to possess wealth.
changed_reading.after: The Hutamah is the inverse operation of hoarding: it disaggregates the assembled world and exposes counted wealth as already perishable debris.

context_deltas.mechanism: The severe-year branch of the focus can act directly on amassed property and on the expectation that it will persist. Gathering everything into a supposedly durable reserve makes the possessor more, not less, legible to an attritional Hutamah: one prolonged scarcity event can break both people and their stored economy.

activation_trace.role: A severe year breaking people and property supplies a literal socioeconomic and ecological crushing regime.
Long wearing-down gives that regime cumulative bodily force.
Completeness without dispersal portrays the reserve as consolidated and apparently protected.
The multiplication of wealth gives prolonged depletion a material target.
Expected persistence supplies the claim that attritional loss falsifies over time.

structural_cues: The wealth sequence in 104:2-3 immediately precedes the casting and naming sequence in 104:4-5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe year, accumulated wealth, and expected persistence; I infer that duration depletes the reserve and its owner together. The explicit fire in 104:6 remains a strong alternative realization, so this model should coexist as an ecological-economic resonance rather than replace it.

changed_reading.before: The focus necessarily denotes an instantaneous fiery event.
changed_reading.after: The focus can additionally evoke a prolonged scarcity regime that crushes the very store meant to guarantee survival and permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's caused knowing confronts a rival epistemology built from enumeration, calculation, and supposition hardened into an inwardly settled expectation. The question is therefore corrective, not merely suspenseful: quantitative control can count possessions yet cannot know the qualitative reality that will break its premise.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge communicated to another supplies the corrective mode of awareness.
Counting supplies a bounded method that mistakes enumerability for mastery.
Calculation links the preceding counting practice to a way of reaching conclusions.
Supposition exposes the conclusion of permanence as belief rather than secured knowledge.
A notion settled in the heart makes the mistaken inference psychologically lodged, preparing the later inward reach.

structural_cues: The subject counts in 104:2, supposes in 104:3, and is then confronted by the second-person knowing formula in 104:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, calculation/supposition, settled inward belief, and caused knowing; I infer a contest between calculative and disclosed knowledge. A live alternative is that the interrogative is only an intensifier and does not specifically answer the earlier epistemic verb.

changed_reading.before: What-made-you-know is a generic rhetorical preface.
changed_reading.after: What-made-you-know interrupts the surah's false calculation and installs a different way of knowing, one capable of exposing the premise behind the count.

context_deltas.mechanism: The collector's direction is reversed. The one who gathered discrete units is himself passively cast as a unit into the named grinder-consumer. The preposition of enclosure and the repeated Hutamah turn the focus from an abstract destructive quality into a staged process with input, chamber, and transformation.

activation_trace.role: The consuming grinder supplies the process into which an input can be fed.
Collecting dispersed units identifies the subject's former role as organizer of inputs.
Throwing or casting converts the former collector into the process's discarded input.
The contextual occurrence locates the casting inside the same consuming-grinder image named again by the focus.

structural_cues: 104:4 uses a passive casting verb followed by فِى and the same definite noun that 104:5 repeats as its unknown.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collection, passive casting into the repeated Hutamah, and a grinder-consumer branch; I supply the feedstock arrow and the collector/collected reversal. The alternative is ordinary spatial casting into a place without an input-processing analogy.

changed_reading.before: The Hutamah is only the destination to which the offender is sent.
changed_reading.after: The Hutamah is a consuming process, and the former collector is inverted into a cast-off unit fed into it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus grinder's fire-like appetite is concretized as an actively kindled fire with explicit divine attribution. Ignition gives the crushing process energy, while the fuel branch keeps open a sustained operating cycle rather than a single flash. Attribution also shifts the model from accidental calamity to purposeful agency.

activation_trace.role: A consumer or grinder likened to fire supplies the focus-side bridge from crushing to combustion.
Blazing fire realizes the grinder's appetite as combustion.
The worshipped deity's name makes ownership and agency explicit, resisting an accidental natural-fire model.
Ignition supplies the causal activation that makes the crusher-consumer operate.
Fuel or combustible material keeps a sustained feed-and-consume mechanism latent within the ignited state.

structural_cues: 104:6 follows the focus immediately and presents a three-part nominal description: fire, divine attribution, and kindled state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, attribution, ignition, fuel, and the focus's fire-like grinder; I infer an energized and sustained consuming apparatus. An alternative is that the fuel branch contributes only lexical background and that the verse describes a blazing state without a feed cycle.

changed_reading.before: The crushing image and the fire image are separate labels for punishment.
changed_reading.after: Ignited fire is the operating medium of the crusher: it consumes, fragments, and remains purposively active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The motion toward the hearts can be read simultaneously as penetration and inspection. The crusher does not stop at an exterior shell; its fire rises into, overlooks, and exposes the inward site where the earlier supposition settled. This echoes the focus's caused knowing: the Hutamah is not only disclosed to the hearer but itself discloses what is inside its subject.

activation_trace.role: Caused awareness supplies the focus-side epistemic frame that inward exposure can answer.
Breaking a resistant shell into fragments supplies the movement from exterior integrity toward exposed interior.
Overlooking and uncovering a matter turns upward reach into diagnostic disclosure.
The heart viewed as an internal ignition point gives the external fire an inward analogue and target.
The fire's arrival as an affliction of the heart makes exposure consequential rather than merely visual.

structural_cues: The relative clause in 104:7 continues the description of the preceding fire and directs its action with عَلَى toward the hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering/overlooking, an internally ignited heart, and affliction reaching it; I infer that physical reach also functions as disclosure of the inward premise. The live alternative is purely somatic penetration with no diagnostic or epistemic force.

changed_reading.before: The Hutamah breaks bodies from the outside.
changed_reading.after: The Hutamah breaches exterior integrity and becomes an inward revealer, reaching the very site of settled calculation and exposing it through internal ignition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Closure prevents what is under pressure from dispersing, supports give the enclosure structural force, and extension gives that force spatial or temporal continuity. The Hutamah can therefore be modeled as a durable pressure chamber: crushing is maintained by an architecture that seals, braces, and prolongs rather than by one uncontained impact.

activation_trace.role: Fragmentation under force supplies the transformation that the surrounding architecture sustains.
Long wearing-down supplies the temporal effect of maintained confinement.
Closing tightly over something prevents release and turns the fire into an enclosing pressure field.
The non-dominant mapped branch's firmly shut door sharpens the enclosure as an engineered barrier.
Bracing a thing with a support gives the closed chamber a load-bearing structure.
Drawing something out in connected length extends the chamber's restraints beyond a single point.
Lengthened time lets architectural extension become sustained duration as well as spatial reach.

structural_cues: 104:8 says the fire is closed over them, and 104:9 continues the spatial description with a prepositional phrase involving extended supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tight closure, a shut door, structural support, connected extension, and prolonged time; I supply the causal arrow from containment to maintained crushing pressure. The alternative is that columns or barriers merely surround the punishment and do not mechanically intensify it.

changed_reading.before: The Hutamah is an unbounded burst of destructive fire.
changed_reading.after: The Hutamah is also a sealed, braced, and extended apparatus whose containment makes crushing cumulative and inescapable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant dominant split mapping of أَدْرَىٰ as spindle rotation and whirlpool motion, then couples it to the focus's grinder branch and later casting and closure. It remains anchored in exact focus branches and a coherent input-motion-enclosure mechanism. Downstream prose must present it only as latent acoustic or imagistic activation, never as a lexical translation of أَدْرَىٰ or as a claim that the verse explicitly describes machinery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus inventory for أَدْرَىٰ supplies rotation and vortex branches beside the Hutamah's consuming-grinder branch.

activation_trace.role: A spindle stabilized by rapid rotation supplies controlled rotary motion at the focus's epistemic threshold.
A dangerous churning whirlpool adds engulfing rotational turbulence to the same split-root activation.
The consuming grinder gives rotational movement a crushing function anchored in the named focus object.
Casting supplies material entering the latent rotary process.
Tight closure contains the churning process and prevents its input from escaping.

changed_reading.before: The interrogative only introduces a static name for destruction.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained latent imagery, the introduction can spin up a sealed vortex-grinder into which material is cast.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split branch of و ص د that pictures a stone enclosure for wealth in a mountain. It remains anchored by the focus branch of worldly wealth as perishing debris and by the packet's explicit wealth accumulation. Render it as an architectural-economic echo: do not claim that مُّؤْصَدَةٌ lexically means treasury here or that the Hutamah is literally a vault.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The Hutamah's focus inventory explicitly includes the perishing debris of worldly display and wealth.

activation_trace.role: Perishing worldly wealth anchors the outlier's inversion in the semantic range of the focus noun.
Accumulating and multiplying wealth supplies what the subject tries to preserve.
Clinging and remaining attached supplies the possessor's bond to the store.
The non-dominant stone enclosure for wealth turns preservation architecture into the latent shape of confinement.

changed_reading.before: The sealed enclosure has no relation to the earlier amassed wealth.
changed_reading.after: The architecture imagined to preserve wealth is inverted into a sealed enclosure where attachment, possessor, and treasure all terminate as debris.

strongest_changes: The focus question became a correction of calculative knowledge, not only a suspense formula.
The crusher became the inverse of collection: assembled and counted wealth is returned to fragments, while the collector becomes cast input.
The fire, inward reach, closure, supports, and extension turned a generic blow into a sustained consuming and exposing apparatus.
The severe-year branch preserved a coexisting attritional and ecological reading instead of being erased by the explicit fire.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several mechanisms at once: social pressure returned at scale, accumulation reversed into debris, false calculation yielded to caused knowing, fire became an energized grinder, and confinement prolonged its inward work. Split and non-dominant mappings also produced contained but genuinely live rotary-vortex and wealth-vault echoes.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the severe-year and long-wearing branches remain active mechanisms after 104:6 or only secondary resonances.
Whether inward ascent primarily indicates physical penetration, diagnostic disclosure, or both.
Whether the extended supports mechanically intensify pressure or only describe containment.
The rotational split-root activation is deliberately form-distant and must not be promoted from latent imagery to lexical meaning.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowing interrupts reckoning.** Evidence: `د ر ي B001` (knowing, awareness, causing to know), activated by `ح س ب B001/B002` in 104:3. Structural cue: ما أدراك follows يحسب. Assigned role: دراية supplies a higher disclosure that corrects حساب. Abductive move: the text contrasts self-produced reckoning with being made to know what exceeds that reckoning. Reading change: the ayah becomes an epistemic break: the reader is moved from the offender's calculation into revealed awareness.

2. **The question aims at the hidden target.** Evidence: `د ر ي B002` (aiming at/setting upon) and `د ر ي B003` (stealth and concealment in hunting), activated by `ط ل ع B003/B004` and `ف ء د B002` in 104:7. Structural cue: the question delays definition until fire reaches the hearts. Assigned role: درى provides the act of approaching a concealed object. Abductive move: because the vice includes hidden لمز and settled inner حساب, true knowledge must stalk and expose what is concealed. Reading change: ما أدراك is not only an awe-formula; it becomes the opening of a targeted investigation.

3. **The repeated name sharpens the crusher.** Evidence: repeated `ح ط م B001`, with `د ر ي B004` (sharp horn/comb-like implement) as exploratory support. Structural cue: الحطمة is named in 104:4, questioned in 104:5, then explained in 104:6-7. Assigned role: repetition holds the object before definition; the sharp implement branch supplies a probing edge. Abductive move: the text makes the reader pause over the name so that "crusher" is felt before its medium is supplied. Reading change: الحطمة changes from an assumed noun into a problem that cuts into the reader's understanding.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 104:7 retrospectively explained why the question needed to interrupt: the answer is not just "fire" but a movement of disclosure toward أفئدة. The later closure in 104:8 also made the question feel like the last opening before knowledge becomes inescapably shut over its object.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge delivered as an operational sequence.** Fixed `أَدْرَىٰكَ` realizes `د ر ي B001`, knowing and causing another to know. The repeated question is followed by fire (`104:6`), inward arrival (`104:7`), sealing (`104:8`), and extended columns (`104:9`). The packet supplies that ordered answer; I infer that each later clause defines a stage rather than merely adding attributes. The question therefore reads as an invitation to learn what `ٱلْحُطَمَةُ` does: ignite, penetrate, close, and structurally maintain pressure.

2. **Exploratory direction into the mechanism.** Fixed `أَدْرَىٰكَ` can activate `د ر ي B002`, aiming at or setting upon something, when later `ط ل ع B006` supplies an ascent or access-point and `ف ء د B003` supplies a heart reached or struck. The packet supplies the interrogative turn and the later inward route; I infer that causing knowledge also directs attention along that route, from name to interior target. On this exploratory reading, the question does not leave the reader outside an unknown object: it aims perception into the Crusher's access-path. The weak link is that the fixed causative form directly favors the knowledge branch.

3. **The Crusher as a consuming processor.** Fixed `ح ط م B008` images a grinder or digester that consumes, and this dormant branch is activated by `و ق د B001` (kindled burning), `ف ء د B001` (heat used to roast or bake), and `ف ء د B002` (the heart as inner kindling). Sealing through `و ص د B001` supplies a closed chamber. The packet gives grinding, heat, an inward object, and enclosure; I infer their coordination as processing stages. `مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ` can consequently ask after an apparatus that reduces and transforms its contents all the way to their inner core, not merely a blow that shatters once.

4. **A scarcity-reading that defeats stored wealth.** Fixed `ح ط م B003` directly includes a severe year, famine, or drought that breaks people and property. Its placement after gathering wealth (`ج م ع B001`, `م و ل B001`) and preparing a reserve (`ع د د B002`) makes that branch functional. The packet supplies accumulation followed by a named breaker; I infer scarcity as the contingency the reserve was meant to master but cannot. This reading coexists with the fiery one supplied next: `ٱلْحُطَمَةُ` can expose the hoarder's fantasy through an economic-ecological mechanism of depletion as well as through material crushing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `104:6`-`104:9` answered the question with verbs and states rather than a synonym: kindling, inward arrival, sealing, and extension. That sequence made `د ر ي B001` causative in a stronger sense, because the packet causes knowledge by walking through the mechanism. The later fiery specification did not erase the separate `ح ط م B003` scarcity-reading; it left it as a parallel activation anchored in the repeated fixed noun and the earlier reserve-building sequence.

baseline.text: Peki, Ezici'nin ne olduğunu sana ne bildirdi?

findings.text: Bu soru, kişinin kendi hesabıyla ürettiği sanıyı keserek onu kendisine bildirilen bir bilgiye geçirir.
Sorunun ardından gelen ateş, içe erişme, kapatma ve destekleme sırası, Ezici'yi bir adla değil işleyiş aşamalarıyla tanıtır.
Soru, dikkati bilinmeyen bir nesnenin dışında bırakmayıp Ezici'nin gizli iç hedefe uzanan yoluna yöneltir.
Ezici, içindekileri yalnızca bir kez kıran değil, kapalı ve ısıtılmış bir süreçte iç merkezlerine kadar dönüştüren tüketici bir düzenek olarak belirir.
Ezici'nin anlam alanındaki kıtlık ve yıkıcı darlık, biriktirilmiş servetin gelecekteki ihtiyacı yenebileceği beklentisini boşa çıkaran ayrı bir olasılık sunar.
Adın soruda tekrarlanmasıyla Ezici'nin anlamının okuyucunun kavrayışını delen keskin bir araştırma aracına dönüştüğü ileri sürülür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Concentrated pressure crosses from speech and gesture into propulsion, forced movement, and the loss of bodily or material integrity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same force pattern extends through compressed articulation, a clenched palm, a prod or bow impulse, a charging mass, and an exhausted driven animal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Crushing by Coalesced Mass
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate bodies gather momentum, overrun what lies before them, and leave brittle matter fragmented.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: brittle fracture and fragmentation (`ح ط م:B001/m01`); trampling herd or ravaging mass (`ح ط م:B006/m01`); coalesced charging force (`ج م ع:B010/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Crushing is not only a single impact. It can be the cumulative force of a herd, flood-like movement, or gathered charge whose parts become one destructive mass and reduce resistant material to fragments.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Harsh Driving and Exhaustion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A harsh driver forces living bodies onward until movement and faculties lose their edge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: violent herding or driving (`ح ط م:B004/m01`); exhaustion of walker, mount, wind, or faculty (`ك ل ل:B001/m02`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The driver is named through the damage he causes: bodies are crowded and driven without relief, while motion, sight, hearing, or cutting power becomes spent and dull.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge is sought or assembled, converted into intention, and then directed toward governance, reconnaissance, hunting, conflict, or formal exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic inquiry develops into administrative oversight, scouting, a concealed hunt, projectile mechanics, treaty renunciation, and sale by thrown token.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Knowing, Testing, and Disclosure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An unknown matter is investigated, tested, learned, and disclosed to another observer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: knowing a matter (`د ر ي:B001/m01`); informing another (`د ر ي:B001/m02`); seeking and testing news (`ح س ب:B010/m01`); inspecting or revealing hidden affairs (`ط ل ع:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Inquiry moves from uncertain report to tested knowledge, then from private discovery to disclosure. Looking into a hidden matter and causing another to know it are consecutive roles in one epistemic process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge is sought or assembled, converted into intention, and then directed toward governance, reconnaissance, hunting, conflict, or formal exchange.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Epistemic inquiry develops into administrative oversight, scouting, a concealed hunt, projectile mechanics, treaty renunciation, and sale by thrown token.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reconnaissance and Deliberate Raid
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Scouts gain sight of an opponent so a force can choose and deliberately approach its target.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reconnaissance party (`ط ل ع:B004/m01`); purposeful targeting or raid (`د ر ي:B002/m01`); deliberate intent (`ع م د:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scout supplies information, intent fixes the objective, and the raid converts knowledge into directed movement. Seeing and striking are ordered stages rather than unrelated acts.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealed Hunt and Projectile Flight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hunter approaches under cover, aims a pointed implement, releases a force-driven projectile, and either reaches the heart or overshoots the mark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: concealed stalking (`د ر ي:B003/m01`); pointed horn or implement (`د ر ي:B004/m01`); bow-driven impulse (`ه م ز:B003/m02`); arrow overshooting its target (`ط ل ع:B010/m01`); strike to the heart (`ف ء د:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment manages distance, the pointed tool and bow concentrate force, and the heart defines the intended endpoint. Overshooting preserves the same trajectory while reversing its outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A visible surface is dressed, encircled, groomed, colored, marked, or made to flash.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Presentation includes a child's undergarment, earrings and bracelets, combing, kohl, depilation, tattoo smoke, livestock branding, crowns, smiles, and gemstone-like sparkle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Combing, Kohl, and Depilation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A pointed grooming tool orders the hair, dark pigment defines the eye or skin, and a preparation removes unwanted hair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hair-combing tool (`د ر ي:B004/m02`); soot used as kohl (`ن و ر:B008/m01`); depilatory preparation (`ن و ر:B009/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Grooming combines shaping, adding pigment, and removing material. The pointed comb, smoke-derived cosmetic, and depilatory preparation operate on different surfaces but share the work of deliberate bodily presentation.

يدخل فيه الفرس أو الدابة الدريرة السريعة، ودرة الساق في الجري، وإدرار الخيل في هيئة رفع اليد في الخبب
يدخل فيه الدردر مغارز الأسنان أو منابت أسنان الصبي، وتدردر اللحم أو البضعة إذا اضطربت وترجرجت، ودردرة الصبي الشيء إذا لاكه، والدردري الذي يذهب ويجيء في غير حاجة

lexicalization_scope.note: Avı hileyle ele geçirme çekirdeği, avcının ardına saklandığı hayvan, avla kurulan özel yapı ve kişiyi kandıran türemiş kullanım olarak ayrı tutulur; özel av kalıbı çıplak anlama genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Avın yerini gözetleyip onu ürkütmeden yaklaşmak, bir hayvanı perde edinerek gizlenmek ve avı aldatarak vurma fırsatı bulmaktır. Aynı hile çekirdeği, türemiş kullanımda bir kişiyi kandırmaya da uzanır.

facets.statement: Avcı, avın yerini henüz açıkça görmeden araştırır ve onu hileyle yaklaşılabilir duruma getirir.
Avcı bir hayvanın ardına saklanır; av bu hayvana alışıp ürkmediğinde atış olanağı doğar.
Gizlenme ve aldatma, avı vurmayı mümkün kılan hazırlık aşamalarıdır; vurmanın kendisi dalın tek başına çekirdeği değildir.
Avcılıktaki hileli yaklaşma, bir kişiyi kandırma anlamına genişleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, avı aldatma ile avcının bir hayvanı gizlenme perdesi olarak kullanmasını aynı avlanma düzeninde birleştirir. Toplu ifade ayrıca avın yerini araştıran ilk aşamayı ve kişi kandırmaya uzanan kullanımı korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, nesnedeki sivrilik çekirdeğinden hayvanın sivri boynuzuna, saçı düzeltmeye yarayan şiş biçimli araca ve saçı bu araçla tarama eylemine uzanan düzenli bir gelişim kurar. Hazırlanmış çerçeve bu türetim zincirini doğru temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sivri uç çekirdeği, boynuz ve belirgin uç adlarıyla birlikte saç düzeltme aracına ve bu araçla yapılan eyleme uzanır; araç ve eylem anlamları çıplak kökün sınırsız anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyde sivri, keskin veya belirgin bir ucun bulunmasıdır; bu özellik hayvanın boynuzunu, dolunca uçları belirginleşen iki memesini ve saçı ayırıp düzeltmede kullanılan şiş biçimli aracı adlandırır. Saçı bu araçla tarayıp düzeltme eylemi de aynı biçimsel temelden türemiştir.

facets.statement: Nesnede sivri, keskin veya belirginleşmiş bir uç bulunur.

Sivri boynuza benzeyen şiş biçimli araç, saçı ayırıp düzeltmek için kullanılır.
Kadının saçını tarayıp düzeltmesi, araç adından türeyen eylem olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sivrilik çekirdeğini boynuz, belirgin uç ve şiş biçimli saç aracı üzerinden kurar. Toplu ifade, araçla saç düzeltme eylemini de bu somut biçim benzerliğinin türevi olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ağır yıl ile kuraklığı bir arada verir ve bu dönemin insanları, malları ve genel olarak karşısına çıkanları çökertici etkisini adlandırma gerekçesi yapar. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, özel bir söz dizimine bağlı olmadan ağır ve kurak yıl adı olarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları ve mallarını ağır biçimde yıpratan, kuraklık ve kıtlıkla geçen sert yıldır. Parçalama düşüncesi burada fiziksel kırmadan, yaşam koşullarını çökerten etkiye aktarılmıştır.

facets.statement: Yıl, kuraklık ve ağır geçim sıkıntısıyla insanları ve malları çökerten bir dönemdir.
Dönemin yıkıcı etkisi, karşısına çıkan şeyi kırıp parçalayan bir güç gibi düşünülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağır yılı ve kuraklığı ortak gönderge olarak verir; adlandırma, bu dönemin insanları ve malları kırıp geçirircesine yıpratmasına dayanır.

concept_gloss.text: insanı ve malı çökerten ağır kıtlık yılı

error_profile.preserves: Ağır yıl, kuraklık ve insanlarla malları çökerten etki birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun yaşadığı kurak ve yıkıcı dönemi doğal Türkçeyle adlandıran bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: İnsanları ve malları kırıp geçirircesine çökerten etkiyi açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanı ve malı çökerten ağır kuraklık yılı

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sürücü ya da çobanın hayvanlara karşı merhametsiz ve aşırı sert davranmasını, onları birbirine çarptırmasını ve iyi otlamalarına engel olmasını aynı kişi niteliğinin görünümleri olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu kişi ve davranış bağını doğru kurar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, özel bir tamlamaya bağlı olmadan hayvanlara sert davranan sürücü veya çoban niteliğini taşır.

concept_map.definition: Hayvanları aşırı sert süren veya güden, onları birbirine çarptırıp ezen ve gereği gibi otlamalarına izin vermeyen merhametsiz sürücü ya da çobandır.

facets.statement: Sürücü veya çoban, bakımındaki hayvanlara karşı merhametsiz ve aşırı sert davranır.
Sert sürüş hayvanları birbirine çarptırıp ezer ve sürünün yeterince otlamasını engelleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklarda kişi, sürüyü ölçüsüz sertlikle yöneten ve hayvanlara acımayan sürücü veya çobandır; bu sertlik birbirine çarpma, ezilme ve otlatmama sonuçlarıyla açıklanır.

concept_gloss.text: sürüyü sertçe sürüp hayvanları birbirine ezen acımasız sürücü
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin rolünü, merhametsiz tutumunu ve sert sürüşün hayvanlar üzerindeki sonucunu birlikte veren karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürücü veya çoban, aşırı sertlik, merhametsizlik ve hayvanları birbirine ezdirme korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin sürüye karşı tutumunun öne çıktığı ve sert sürüş biçiminin bağlamdan anlaşıldığı kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çoban rolünü ve hayvanlara karşı merhametsiz tutumu korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanları birbirine çarptırma ve yeterince otlatmama biçimindeki özel sonuçları söylemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yaşlanıp güçten düşme çekirdeğini destekler, ancak bunu tek bir yalın anlam gibi vermez: yaşlı ve zayıf at betimlemesi ile hayvanın yaşlanması, yaşın kişiyi çökertmesi ve kişinin yakınları arasında uzun süre yaşlanması ayrı söz dizimlerinde gerçekleşir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat her kullanımın sınırı belirtilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yaşlı ve güçsüz atı belirten biçim ile hayvanın, yaşın veya yakınlar arasında geçen uzun sürenin özne olduğu tamlamalı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: İnsan ya da hayvanın yaşlılık, uzun ömür veya zayıflık yüzünden bedence çökmesi ve güçten düşmesidir. Atı doğrudan niteleyen kullanım ile yaşın, hayvanın yaşlanmasının veya yakınları arasında geçirilen uzun sürenin bu sonucu doğurduğu tamlamalar birbirine genellenmez.

facets.statement: Yaşlanma veya zayıflama, insan ya da hayvanın bedenini çökmüş ve güçsüz duruma getirir.
At, ileri yaş veya zayıflık nedeniyle çökmüş ve güçten düşmüş olarak nitelenir.
Belirli tamlamalarda yaş veya yakınları arasında geçirilen uzun süre, kişinin yaşlanıp çökmüş duruma gelmesinin nedeni olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, yaşlılık ve zayıflığın atı, başka bir hayvanı veya insanı çökmüş ve güçsüz hale getirmesini ortaklaştırır; özne ve neden, her söz diziminde ayrıca korunmalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: yaşlılıkla çöküp güçten düşmek
concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan ve hayvandaki yaşlanma kaynaklı bedensel çöküş çekirdeğini verir; özel tamlamaların katılımcıları ayrıca belirtilmelidir.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşlılık, bedensel çöküş ve güç kaybı ortak çekirdek olarak korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yaşın insanı veya hayvanı bedence zayıflattığı bağlamlarda doğal bir eylem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşlanma ile ortaya çıkan bedensel çöküş ve güç kaybını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalnızca zayıflıktan çökmüş atı ve yakınlar arasında geçen uzun süreye bağlı özel kullanımı kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı gerçekleşmeyi aynı yıkıcı hareket altında toplar: kalabalık deve veya koyun sürüsü karşılaştığını ve otlağı ezer, aslan ise mala saldırıp kırıp geçirir. Dal korunabilir, ancak hayvan topluluğu ile yırtıcı saldırısı tek bir göndergeymiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, kalabalık sürüyü adlandıran biçimi aslanın mala verdiği zararı bildiren kısıtlı söz öbeğinden ayrı tanımlar.

concept_map.definition: Karşısına çıkan şeyi, özellikle otlağı ezip tüketen kalabalık deve veya koyun sürüsüdür. Ayrı ve söz öbeğine bağlı kullanımda, aslanın mala saldırıp kırıp geçirmesini anlatır.

facets.statement: Kalabalık deve veya koyun sürüsü, ilerlerken karşısına çıkanları ve otlağı ezip tüketir.
Kısıtlı bir söz öbeğinde aslanın mala saldırması, zarar vermesi ve kırıp geçirmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt kalabalık sürünün karşılaştığı şeyi ve otlağı ezmesini temel görünüm olarak verir; aynı yıkıcı hareket alanında aslanın mala saldırısı için kısıtlı bir kullanım da bulunur.

concept_gloss.text: karşısına çıkanı ezen kalabalık sürü veya aslanın mala saldırısı
concept_gloss.applicability: Kalabalık sürü anlamı ile aslanın mala saldırısını ortak yıkıcı etki üzerinden, kapsamlarını ayırarak temsil eder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çok yiyen kişiyi ve yiyeceği öğütüp sindiren diş ya da organı aynı tüketme benzetmesi çevresinde toplar, fakat bunlar aynı gönderge değildir. Dal ortak işlevsel görüntüyle korunabilir; kişi niteliği ile öğütücü veya sindirici araç anlamı ayrı yüzler olarak yazılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalda bulunan iki biçimin kişi ve öğütücü organ göndergeleri ayrı tutulur; biri ötekinin genel tanımı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda çok ve durmaksızın yiyen kişiyi, başka bir kullanımda ise yiyeceği öğütüp sindiren diş, organ veya şeyi anlatır. İki görünüm, önüne geleni yok edercesine tüketme düşüncesinde birleşir.

facets.statement: Kişi, çok miktarda ve önünde kalanı tüketircesine yemekle nitelenir.
